create_Jitted_wrapper: create a Jitted wrapper around a Penzai layer to run it under JIT compilation
run_Jitted_layer: run a Jitted-wrapped Penzai layer with an argument under JIT compilation
inspect_Jitted_body: inspect the body attribute of a Jitted wrapper to access the wrapped layer

review_Jitted_recompile: review how modifying the body of a Jitted wrapper triggers automatic recompilation
